gemini.performance_metric: net income attributable to the company of $1,147 million in fiscal 2022
gemini.rationale: The slice documents restructuring programs to optimize operational and organizational structures and a shift to a global business unit model, but does not document any realized disruption or fracture at the product/process or process/organization interfaces. Therefore, p4 and p5 are coded as 0.

grok.performance_metric: FY2022 net income $1,147M; third consecutive profitable year
grok.rationale: The slice documents rising seed and crop-protection net sales and positive net income through FY2022, with no realized product-line/operations incoherence, so p4_pathway is 0. Restructuring and the shift to a global business unit model are framed as productivity optimization with a 'strong employee base,' not as operations fracturing against organization/culture, so p5_pathway is 0.

openai.performance_metric: $1,147 million net income in FY2022, the third consecutive year of positive net income
openai.rationale: No realized product/process-interface disruption is documented; both seed and crop-protection sales increased in 2022 (Form 10-K FY2022, SEC accession 0001755672-23-000005). The successive productivity and restructuring programs optimized operational and organizational structures and accompanied a shift to a global business-unit model, but the slice does not document operations breaking against people, management, or culture; the company also described its approximately 21,000 employees as a key element of its success (same source).
